title: Final Probability Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The correct probability for finding the particle in the ground state of the new potential must be provided.

title: Final Time Condition
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for the time T that restores the initial ground state must be stated.

title: Wave Function Transition
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the transition between wave functions before and after the change in spring constant.

title: Energy Eigenstates
description: Important Criteria: The response should include the concept of expanding the initial state in terms of the new potential's eigenstates.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the expressions for energy or wave functions.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response should not omit any necessary factors in the final probability or time expressions.
